StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Resident_Evil:_Revelations_2

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 287290 ("Resident Evil Revelations 2"; the schema has no game name). RAWG's first result is the full game ("re-revelations-2"), as expected; RAWG keeps Episodes 1 to 3 as separate entries named "Penal Colony", "Contemplation" and "Judgment". The Episode 4 name "Metamorphosis" comes from StrategyWiki's page names (Claire/ and Barry/ pages for Penal Colony, Contemplation, Judgment and Metamorphosis); that it is the fourth episode is inferred because it is the only other one. StrategyWiki has "Resident Evil: Revelations 2" at completion stage 0: of the eight Claire and Barry episode pages only Claire/Penal Colony, Barry/Penal Colony and Claire/Contemplation are written (about 4,300 to 7,200 characters each), plus Skills and Table of Contents, so it was not used. It also lists "The Struggle" and "Little Miss" pages (not written); there are no Steam achievements for them, so they have no chapter. residentevil.fandom.com answers the API under "Resident Evil: Revelations 2", with about 194 linked articles (mostly cast and series pages, plus "Raid Mode (Revelations 2)"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 43 Steam achievements is hidden. "Bounty Hunter" (50,000 BP) has the API name ACH_CAMPAINF_PT_MEDIUM, so it sits in the combat chapter rather than Raid Mode; that needs checking.
